It typically has features such as adjustable line thickness, different brush styles, and an eraser tool. To use the app, the user first selects an image to trace or takes a new photograph.
Place phone about 1feet above and look into the phone and draw on paper...........



- So how does it works?
- Select an image from the app or gallery apply filter to create image traceable. After that, you will see that image on the camera screen with transparency & you have to put drawing paper or book anything on which you want to trace and draw. Your image will not appear on paper but a transparent image with camera so that you can trace it on paper.
- Draw on paper by looking at the phone with a transparent image.
- Select any image and convert it to a tracing image.
